description: POST raw markdown as the request body and get plain text back. Removes headings, emphasis, links (keeps the label), images (keeps the alt text), list markers, blockquotes, HTML tags and code fences (keeps code contents). Useful before summarizing or indexing markdown documents. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/markdown-strip.
name: markdown-strip
